$$

The time taken for the remaining two-thirds is:

$$
t_2 = \frac{2d/3}{90} = \frac{2d}{270} = \frac{d}{135}
$$

The total time $T$ is the sum of these times:

$$

$$

Finally, the average speed is:

$$
\text{Average Speed} = \frac{d}{T} = \frac{d}{d/54} = 54\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}
$$

$$

The curve has a stationary point at $x=1$, which implies $f'(1) = 0$. Differentiating $f(x)$ gives $f'(x) = 2ax + b$, so:

$$

$$
\int_0^1 (ax^2 + bx) \, \mathrm{d}x = \left[ \frac{ax^3}{3} + \frac{bx^2}{2} \right]_0^1 = \frac{a}{3} + \frac{b}{2}
$$

$$
\frac{a}{3} + \frac{b}{2} = 4
$$

$$
2a + 3(-2a) = 24 \implies -4a = 24
$$

Thus, $a = -6$.

$$

The total maximum displacement is $s(2) + \Delta s = 8 + 9 = 17\,\mathrm{m}$.
